introduction: Follow Valois’s family-seal requests, the dwarf’s crafting models, the wine-to-dinner delivery, Madam Oakencrest’s two flower gifts and the ambassador’s overdue note. Each card distinguishes current proof from an accepted outcome.
orientation: The active Surface plain leads NORTH to Valois’s dusty road38575; SOUTH returns to the Surface. Roads lead toward the castle, royal shops, three inhabited estates and the old tavern. Native gates, guards and terrain still apply; source locations do not promise safe access.

Ask King Ulgris hi, king or quest. Ask the hearty dwarf hi, quest, dwarf, old, hearty or mountain; the stealthy figure hi, shadowy, figure, dark, assassin or king; the bakery cook hi, quest, cook, bakery or wine; the elven ambassador hi, quest, note, elven, ambassador or porter. These are five response families with twenty-six aliases, not twenty-six achievements.

The king’s family-seal bundle uses Oakencrest, Du’kel and Berani, each a distinct item. The assassin’s bundle uses the prince and princess, also distinct. Seal and ring names do not prove personal kills. A matching gift can satisfy a hand-in without proving you recovered it from the named person.

The dwarf wants four crafting models together: mace, polearm, sleeves and leggings. Royal guards following the chamberlain wield maces; patrolling pikemen wield polearms; the royal smiths carry models too. The dwarf gives one leggings reward and departs. Native stock/caps and actual recipient renewal determine whether another attempt is available.

The vineyard keeper’s key opens the pickproof cellar door DOWN from38525 to38526. It breaks on a successful unlock. SEARCH for the hidden quest wine in the cellar, then take the exact bottle to the bakery cook38551. His dinner plate goes to Queen Napolia in the third-floor dining room38475 for the royal token. Wine possession, a cook receipt, current plate and queen receipt remain separate.

The beautiful roses start in Du’kel’s courtyard38495 beyond the exterior keyed gate; its crimson key comes from a loyal swordsman at38484. The white rose starts worn by a former soldier in Oakencrest’s courtyard38534. Madam Oakencrest on balcony38546 accepts these as two separate gift exchanges. No magical garden belt or extra relationship scene is inferred.

The castle has public and private gardens and secret UP/DOWN ladder pairs to royal balconies. Their native reset state is secret, closed and unlocked; the ordinary garden doors are closed, not a new magical quest barrier. Finding or seeing an open ladder or another player’s unlocked gate does not record your own access action.

The elven ambassador waits in38451 while the red porter carries the exact note in38454. Read its description if useful, but the native exchange does not check personal reading or language knowledge. Other ambassadors’ trade, the king’s wider politics and the monk’s library are supporting stories without authored accepted endpoints.

F resets load the chamberlain’s royal guards and replace the current item holder for subsequent equipment. No local teleport or switch prototype is present. The Wailing Griffon room flag registers the shared inn handler even though there is no literal local assignment. The swordsman’s _spec1_ keyword selects class specialization; it is not a quest gate procedure.

Fifteen Veralis Mansion rooms have explicit unfinished descriptions and no connection to the main local road component. Two banquet rooms form another isolated component. These are builder review items, not new passages or completion requirements. The mere existence of unplaced mobile prototypes does not authorize spawning them.

All eight native exchanges have exact input, reward and acceptance identities. Current loose proof, gifts, source recovery, addressed dialogue, reading, keyed access, combat and accepted receipts are different facts. The optional cook history never blocks a matching supplied dinner plate or restores a consumed one.

Static daily candidates require actual material, stock and recipient renewal under native mode1. All new discovery, encounter, journal, achievement and daily credit requires active, ready accounting; frozen recovery stays separate. No native zone/quest repair, pickup, key, route, shop or mobility change ships.
